title: Ink & Riddle
description: Explore witty Chinese-character brain teasers and ink-wash puzzle stages where every stroke, radical, and pun unlocks a surprising solution.
controls: Tap, drag, or combine Chinese characters and scene objects to solve each brain-teaser stage.

zh-CN.title: 汉字找梗
zh-CN.description: 国风手绘水墨脑洞汉字闯关：拆字组字、爆笑热梗找茬、反转谜题一关接一关停不下来。
zh-CN.controls: 点击、拖拽或拆合画面中的汉字与道具，发挥脑洞找出隐藏热梗即可过关。
